# Anne Shirley & Faith

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Faith](../character/faith.md) — confidante and trusted friend · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND P1](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND P10](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0010)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Miss Cornelia investigates Mary Vance's situation, revealing that her abusive former guardian has died. Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where Walter reads mythic stories aloud and speaks solemnly about following the [Pied Piper](../character/pied-piper.md). [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) arrives with the news of Mrs. Wiley's death, prompting Mary to express both relief and anxiety over her uncertain future.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P23](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P39](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0039)_

> After [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) cautions Mr. Meredith about [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), Mr. Meredith speaks kindly to Mary and alleviates her fears. Encouraged by [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) boldly visits [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) to ask if she will adopt Mary. [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) agrees after consulting Marshall, and Mary prepares to move to her new home while sharing her frank thoughts on life and stepmothers with [Una](../character/una-meredith.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P5](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P17](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P42](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0042), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080)_

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) and Walter ride pigs through [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary on a dare, which [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) observe as they drive by. Later at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to discuss Faith's church address and pig-riding escapade, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) defend the children.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE

AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE P17](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0017)_

> [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) visit [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) to discuss recent town events, including the death of [Myra Murray](../character/myra-murray.md) and parish church politics. After learning that Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md) has left the church and threatens to pull support, [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) tells [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) about the danger to her father's position. [Faith](../character/faith.md) resolves to take action to save her family from having to leave [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P0](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P23](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XV. > After [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) confronts him and agrees to a fight the next evening. Despite his dread, Walter wins the battle after school, defending [Faith](../character/faith.md) and his mother. On his way home through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), he meets Mr. Meredith, who approves of his fighting for a good cause, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later comforts him after hearing what happened.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P11](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. > Walter reports his courage to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who comforts him after his fight. Downstairs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss Walter's fight and gossip about Mr. Meredith's potential romance with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P73](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0073), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P75](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0075), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. > [Faith](../character/faith.md) causes a scandal in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary by attending church without stockings, sparking community gossip and concern among [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) and Miss Cornelia. In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the other children discuss the incident, and Jerry punishes [Faith](../character/faith.md) via the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) by making her wear her hated striped stockings. To clear her father of any blame, [Faith](../character/faith.md) writes a detailed letter of explanation to the local newspaper.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION”

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION” P0](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXV. > Cornelia Elliott discusses the minister's children and their graveyard performance with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Prompted by Cornelia's feedback, Mr. Meredith confronts his children about singing in the churchyard during the prayer meeting. After addressing their thoughtlessness gently, Mr. Meredith mourns his parenting abilities and longs for [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P1](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P10](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. > Jerry decrees punishments for his siblings' cowardice, ordering [Carl](../character/carl.md) to sit alone in the graveyard until midnight. [Carl](../character/carl.md) bravely completes the ordeal in a chilling rainstorm, but comes down with severe pneumonia as a result. After fighting through a dangerous crisis with Dr. Blythe's care, [Carl](../character/carl.md) recovers and is welcomed back by his friends and family.
>

> In the evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss the upcoming double wedding and the arrangements for the children while the newlyweds are away. Meanwhile, in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the children gather on Jem's last evening before he leaves for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Walter and [Jem](../character/jem.md) speak of battles and following the Pied Piper's call into the future.
>
